name: Cafe Crush
source:
Presenting Café Crush, a short choice driven visual novel where you manage to land a part-time job working at Kitty Café, a quaint little coffee shop and bakery run by three cute girls, Lily the bubbly waitress, Josie the aloof barista and Emilia the shy pastry chef. Work your way through each day, completing mini-games and serving customers while chatting with each of your colleagues to try and win them over. Who knows, maybe at the end of the week you'll snag a date with your favourite girl.

Café Crush is fully voiced featuring a selection of engaging mini-games and quizzes as well as a point system to help track your relationship progress with each girl. Discover their favourite things and buy them their ideal gift to get a date!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075390/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《Café Crush》，一部由选择推动的短篇视觉小说。你成功在小猫咖啡馆找到了一份兼职工作。这家古雅的小店兼营咖啡与烘焙，由三个可爱的女孩经营：活泼的服务员莉莉、冷淡的咖啡师乔茜，以及害羞的糕点师艾米莉亚。每天，你都要完成小游戏、招待顾客，并与同事们聊天，努力赢得她们的好感。说不定到了周末，你就能约到自己最喜欢的女孩。

《Café Crush》采用全语音演出，包含多种有趣的小游戏和问答，并通过积分系统记录你与各个女孩的关系进展。了解她们喜欢的事物，买下她们心仪的礼物，争取一次约会吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075390/]Steam[/url]]
